auth.sessionExpiredBody: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue. Protected data from the previous session is no longer available.
auth.loginBody: Healthcare Web uses your organization identity provider. Username and password are not collected in this application.
auth.oidcMissing: The identity provider is not configured for this environment. Set VITE_OIDC_ISSUER and VITE_OIDC_CLIENT_ID.
auth.callbackError: Sign-in could not be completed. Try again.

org.selectBody: Choose the healthcare organization for this tab. Another tab can use a different organization.
org.unassignedBody: Your account is provisioned, but you are not assigned to a healthcare organization. This application is not Platform Admin.

facility.label: Work facility
facility.requiredBody: Your access in this organization is limited to specific facilities. Choose a work facility before continuing. This is not a chart filter.
facility.allInOrganizationHint: You may work across accessible facilities in this organization. A work facility is optional and does not filter the future clinical chart.

workspace.homeBody: Select a workspace from the navigation. Patient lookup and clinical chart are not part of this shell.
workspace.empty: This workspace is not implemented yet. No patient or clinical data is shown.
workspace.noWorkspaces: No workspaces are available for your permissions in this organization.

errors.forbiddenBody: You cannot open this area with your current organization permissions. The server remains the authority.
